summary:
[  edit  ]
The Lsystem  SOP  implements L-systems (Lindenmayer-systems, named after Aristid Lindenmayer (1925-1989)), allow definition of complex shapes through the use of iteration. They use a mathematical language in which an initial string of characters is evaluated repeatedly, and the results are used to generate geometry. The result of each evaluation becomes the basis for the next iteration of geometry, giving the illusion of growth.
You begin building an L-system by defining a sequence of rules which are evaluated to produce a new string of characters. Each character of the new string represents one command which affects an imaginary stylus, or "turtle". Repeating this process will grow your geometry.
You can use L-systems to create things such as:
Create organic objects such as trees, plants, flowers over time.
Create animated branching objects such as lightning and snowflakes.
The file can be read in from disk or from the web. Use http:// when specifying a URL.
The Algorithmic Beauty of Plants
The descriptions located here should be enough to get you started in writing your own L-system rules, however, if you have any serious interests in creating L-systems, you should obtain the book:
The Algorithmic Beauty of Plants
Przemyslaw Prusinkiewicz & Aristid Lindenmayer
Springer-Verlag, New York, Phone: 212.460.1500
ISBN: 0-387-94676-4, 1996.
which is the definitive reference on the subject. It contains a multitude of L-systems examples complete with descriptions of the ideas and theories behind modelling realistic plant growth.

parameters.label: Type
parameters.name: type
parameters.description: ⊞  - Provides two options for output geometry:

parameters.label: Skeleton
parameters.name: skel
parameters.description: Creates wire frame geometry. This option is ideal for geometry that is stiff and jagged like lightning or snowflakes. It is also useful to reduce  SOP  cooking time.

parameters.label: Tube
parameters.name: tube
parameters.description: Creates tube geometry. This option can be used with solid geometry that would need smooth curves, like trees or shrubs. Parameters on the  Tube Page  are only enabled when this Type is selected.

parameters.label: Generations
parameters.name: generations
parameters.description: Determines the number of times to apply the rules to the initial string. This value controls the growth of the L-system. Place a time-based function here to animate the L-system growth.

parameters.label: Random Scale
parameters.name: randscale
parameters.description: Random Scale as a percentage. This will apply a random scale to the changing geometry's lengths, angles and thickness.

parameters.label: Random Seed
parameters.name: randseed
parameters.description: Random Seed for the  SOP . This value can be used to select different sequences of random values.

parameters.label: Continuous Angles
parameters.name: contangl
parameters.description: Calculates the incremental angles of branches, if a non-integer generational value is used. If the Generations field is animating, this should be set to ensure smooth growth.

parameters.label: Continuous Length
parameters.name: contlength
parameters.description: Calculates the incremental lengths of the geometry points if a non-integer generational value is used. As with Continuous Angles, if the Generations field is animating, this should be set to ensure smooth, continuous growth. The Continuous Width field applies to tube thickness.

parameters.label: Continuous Width
parameters.name: contwidth
parameters.description: Calculates the incremental lengths of the geometry points if a non-integer generational value is used. As with Continuous Angles, if the Generations field is animating, this should be set to ensure smooth, continuous growth. The Continuous Width field applies to tube thickness.

parameters.label: Apply Color
parameters.name: docolor
parameters.description: Use a  TOP  to apply color to the L-system as it grows.

parameters.label: Image File
parameters.name: colormap
parameters.description: Defines a  TOP  to use when the Apply Color button is selected. Also see the ` and # turtle operators.

parameters.label: UV Increment
parameters.name: inc
parameters.description: ⊞  - Defines the default color U, V index increments when the turtle symbols ` or # are used.

parameters.label: Point Width Attribute
parameters.name: pointwidth
parameters.description: Adds a point  width  attribute to each point in the geometry. This width is effected by the Thickness and Thickness Scale parameters on the Tube Page.

parameters.label: Rows
parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: The first option sets the number of tube sides and the second sets the number of divisions per step length if tube geometry is selected.

parameters.label: Columns
parameters.name: cols
parameters.description: The first option sets the number of tube sides and the second sets the number of divisions per step length if tube geometry is selected.

parameters.label: Tension
parameters.name: tension
parameters.description: Tension defines the smoothness of branching corners.

parameters.label: Branch Blend
parameters.name: smooth
parameters.description: Enabling this option allows a child branch to be continuously joined to its parent branch.

parameters.label: Thickness
parameters.name: thickinit
parameters.description: This number defines the default tube thickness.

parameters.label: Thickness Scale
parameters.name: thickscale
parameters.description: This number is the scale factor used with the ! or ? operator.

parameters.label: Apply Tube Texture Coordinates
parameters.name: dotexture
parameters.description: When enabled, UV texture coordinates are applied to the tube segments, such that the texture wraps smoothly and continuously over branches.

parameters.label: Vertical Increment
parameters.name: vertinc
parameters.description: Defines the vertical spacing of texture coordinates over tube geometry when tube texture is applied.

parameters.label: Step Size
parameters.name: stepinit
parameters.description: Step Size allows you to define the default length of the edges when new geometry is generated.

parameters.label: Step Size Scale
parameters.name: stepscale
parameters.description: Step Size Scale defines the scale by which the geometry will be modified by the " or _ (double quote, or underscore) turtle operators.

parameters.label: Angle
parameters.name: angleinit
parameters.description: Angle defines the default turning angle for turns, rolls and pitches.

parameters.label: Angle Scale
parameters.name: anglescale
parameters.description: Angle Scale allows you to enter the scaling factor to be employed when the ; or @ operators are used.

parameters.label: Variable b
parameters.name: varb
parameters.description: Substitutes user-defined b, c and d variables in rules or premise. These variables are expanded and so may include system variables such as  $F  and  $T .

parameters.label: Variable c
parameters.name: varc
parameters.description: Substitutes user-defined b, c and d variables in rules or premise. These variables are expanded and so may include system variables such as  $F  and  $T .

parameters.label: Variable d
parameters.name: vard
parameters.description: Substitutes user-defined b, c and d variables in rules or premise. These variables are expanded and so may include system variables such as  $F  and  $T .

parameters.label: Gravity
parameters.name: gravity
parameters.description: This parameter determines the amount of gravity applied to the geometry via the T (tropism vector) turtle operator.  Tropism  is when a plant bends or curves in response to an external stimulus. L-systems employ a tropism vector to simulate this behaviour. The bending is characterised by the fact that the thicker or shorter parts bend less than the longer or thinner parts.
